Our team is about to upgrade the local AI assistant installation on the dev machine. Before we do anything, we need a safe point-in-time snapshot of its current configuration folder so we can roll back instantly if something breaks.

The configuration lives in a hidden folder called `.openclaw` inside the home directory. Please create a full backup of it right now. The backup must sit right next to the original folder, include every single file — even the hidden ones buried inside subdirectories — and keep all the original file permissions exactly as they are.

The workspace home directory is at `/root/workspace` (treat it as `$HOME` for this task). The project already has a `scripts/` directory with the relevant tooling in place.
